newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese export outlook rosy til end-1996 - INE.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese export outlook rosy til end-1996 - INE.

text.p: The outlook for Portuguese exports will improve before the end of this year, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.

"The improvement in expectations of businesses and of some European economies, notably Germany, point to a more favourable trend for exports until the end of the present year," INE said in its monthly report for August.
The report said that "during the three months ending in August an improvement in the economic climate continued to be seen in the construction and manufacturing sectors."
It said: "Industrial companies saw their foreign order books rise, although there were drops in some indicators of family spending and investment."
PORTUGUESE INDICATORS Jun 96 Jul 96 Last 3 months
